Armani Hotels & Resorts is heading for the Red Sea. The brand will open its first hotel in Egypt in 2030 at Marassi Red Sea, a new resort on the coast about 25 km from Hurghada. The project was announced in Cairo on 23 November 2026, and La Revue des Hôtels reported it the next day.

## What is planned

The address will combine an Armani Hotel with rooms and beach suites, serviced apartments with hotel services, and a limited number of private Armani-branded residences. It sits on the beachfront facing the marina. Interiors will follow the Armani/Casa aesthetic, and a wellness sanctuary will focus on restoration and longevity. The number of rooms, the architect and the rates have not been disclosed and remain to be confirmed.

Giuseppe Marsocci, chief executive of the Armani Group, says every detail will reflect "the philosophy Mr. Armani defined across five decades". Mohamed Alabbar, founder of Emaar, describes the project as a new benchmark for luxury on the Red Sea.

## A twenty-year partnership

The developer is Emaar Misr, the Egyptian arm of the Dubai group Emaar. Giorgio Armani S.p.A. and Emaar Properties created Armani Hotels & Resorts together in 2005. The first Armani Hotel opened in 2010 inside the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, with 160 rooms and suites. Armani Hotel Milano followed on Via Manzoni, with 95 rooms. Armani Hotel Diriyah, near Riyadh, is under construction.

Marassi Red Sea itself is planned on 10 million m², with 12 hotels and serviced residences, three marinas and a yacht club. Emaar's 2025 annual report values the development at about €15.1 billion.

## The signal

Fashion houses are no longer content to lend their name to a hotel. With Emaar, Armani is building a whole destination around its style, from the beach suites to the residences for sale. For hoteliers on the Red Sea, the competition now includes the world's best-known fashion names.

Congratulations to the Armani and Emaar teams on this new address.
summary: Armani Hotels & Resorts and Emaar will open the brand's first Egyptian hotel at Marassi Red Sea in 2030, with beach suites and Armani residences.
title: Armani takes its hotels to Egypt's Red Sea
why: One of fashion's best-known names builds a whole Red Sea destination with Emaar.
